source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Check the inspection report every day.
3. Compare records to the last test date.
4. Check to see if water is sent out in a timely manner.
5. Follow-up on outstanding tests.
6. Review lab log and phone log of calls to water facilities.
7. Check and verify that calls are being received in a timely manner and recorded in the calls report.
8. Call to investigate complaints about water supply and water services as necessary.
9. Refer to inspection reports and check for discrepancies.
10. Check for correct records, if there are missing records, refer to the lab log (as needed) and check the inspection logs and other important records.
11. Ensure that a water facility has the required employees for the facility so that adequate testing can be performed.
12. Check to see if records have been placed in the correct folder and that records have been placed in the correct
